cohort: Pregnant women between 28-40 weeks gestation, 50 with appropriate for gestational age fetuses and 50 with small for gestational age fetuses (41 constitutional SGA and 9 with IUGR).
finding: The myocardial performance index of both the right and left ventricles was significantly higher from 30 weeks gestation until delivery in small for gestational age fetuses compared to appropriate for gestational age fetuses.
